item.title: Show HN: Open-Source Article 12 Logging Infrastructure for the EU AI Act
item.description:
📝 With this in mind, we built a small free, open-source TypeScript library for Node apps using the Vercel AI SDK that captures inference as an append-only log. There is also a coverage command that flags likely gaps (in practice omissions are a bigger risk than edits). Blog post with link to repo: https://systima.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47230438

item.title: Pass-Through of Tariffs: Evidence from European Wine Imports
item.description:
📝 Evidence from European Wine Tariffs (NBER Working Paper 34392), Aaron B. They compare price changes for tariffed wines (still wines at or below 14 percent ABV) with price changes for a control group consisting of sparkling wines and still wines exceeding 14 percent ABV from producers selling only nontariffed products. 2 percent relative to the control group following the 25 percent tariff, absorbing about 20 percent of the tariff rate.
🔗 Read more: https://www.nber.org/202603/digest/pass-through-tariffs-evidence-european-wine-imports
